_comment: Example per-role model configuration for minimax-code-cycle-plugin. Copy to ~/.mavis/cycle/config.json and adjust. Each user picks their own model and provider. The plugin is model-agnostic. The model is the string the host accepts in its agent configuration (typically 'provider/model-id').

_roles_explained.architect: Strong reasoning, long context, careful planning. Heavy cost, used once per workflow.
_roles_explained.executor: Strong code generation, fast iteration, good at following scoped tasks. The workhorse.
_roles_explained.functional_reviewer: Fast, careful, good at end-to-end consistency checks. Used for cross-layer completeness.
_roles_explained.security_reviewer: Strong at adversarial thinking, dependency risk, architecture integrity. Should match or exceed executor's reasoning.
_roles_explained.arbiter: The most careful reasoner. The only role that can approve. Errs on the side of 'one more check'.
